context_files_read.purpose: Read controlling repository safety, artifact, harness, real-evidence, and P14 rules.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; charts, HTML, and markdown reports are views.
Missing metrics must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and never invented.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is not automatic and must not run without explicit opt-in.
Protected harness files, schemas, scripts, templates, and historical gate controls must not be weakened or edited to hide changes.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm automatic loop boundary and 1000-node dry-run constraints.
key_findings: The automatic loop completes at P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14 may only run when VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN is explicitly set to I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_IS_NOT_A_DEFAULT_GATE.
Reports and views must read artifacts and must not become the source of truth.

context_files_read.purpose: Read risk_auditor JSON contract and stage flow requirements.
key_findings: risk_auditor output must be a JSON file under the stage subagents directory.
The role must identify risks around forgery, skipped work, dry-run confusion, resource exhaustion, and harness weakening.
Main implementation may proceed only if the risk audit has no unresolved high-severity blocker.

context_files_read.purpose: Read artifact-first, missing-data, real-evidence, and anti-regression requirements.
key_findings: Metric and report work must read machine-readable artifacts, not Markdown reports.
1000+ behavior is dry-run/resource/planner by default and cannot count as real Valkey coverage.
Real Valkey evidence requires real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x, observed node count, cluster/data-path proof, cleanup PASS, and schema validation PASS.
Anti-regression must block required-to-optional changes, real_valkey downgrades, min-node lowering, schema loosening, unreasoned skips, and manual PASS edits.

context_files_read.purpose: Read L03 stage goal, required harness additions, and acceptance criteria.
key_findings: L03 must create schemas/artifact/metric_catalog.schema.json and schemas/artifact/coverage_matrix.schema.json.
L03 must create scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py and tests verifying fake plus real artifact coverage.
Each metric needs name, unit, source_artifact, scenario, node_count_scope, and missing semantics.
The coverage matrix must layer fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run coverage and must not count 1000 dry-run as real coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Read L03 validation expectations and commands that remain out of scope for this subagent.
key_findings: L03 validation is expected to run scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py and tests/metrics tests/coverage.
1000+ dry-run validation commands are documented separately and must not count as real Valkey coverage.
This risk audit did not run P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.

context_files_read.purpose: Read stage-local scope, constraints, and known risks.
key_findings: L03 must build metric catalog and coverage matrix from machine-readable artifacts.
Coverage must explicitly separate fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers.
P14 dry-run evidence must not count as real coverage.
Historical phase and gate artifacts must not be mutated to make metric coverage look better.

context_files_read.purpose: Verify previous harness status and command boundary for L03.
key_findings: Previous harness status is PASS.
The record says no P14, real Valkey wrapper, or fault wrapper command was run during L03 previous harness.
Timestamp-only audit/provenance churn and tracked bytecode were restored after baseline validation.

context_files_read.purpose: Use prior-stage result as provenance baseline for L03.
key_findings: L02 status is PASS at commit 3aeb587ede3364bd1158813ded6092f95580a990.
L02 produced artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json.
L02 was static provenance analysis only and did not rerun P14, real Valkey wrappers, or fault wrappers.
L02 explicitly left historical optional metadata as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON rather than inventing values.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect provenance baseline, source/view node counts, and remaining metadata findings.
key_findings: The graph status is PASS with 95 nodes, 70 edges, 89 source-of-truth nodes, and 6 report-view nodes.
There are zero blocking findings, zero missing sources, zero hash mismatches, and 11 missing metadata findings.
P09, P11, P12, and P13 phase coverage is present.
There are no P14 nodes or edges, matching P14 not being run.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect committed artifact audit inventory and P14 boundary.
key_findings: Audit status is PASS with 14 phases, 59 artifacts, 14 gate results, 0 blocking findings, and 13 real evidence records in summary.
P14 boundary is SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, automatic false, dry_run_only true, real_valkey_coverage false, and real_evidence_count 0.
Historical nonblocking findings include manifest SHA mismatches and a P13 scale_tests command mismatch.
Those historical findings must not be hidden by L03 catalog or matrix aggregation.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect existing 1000-node dry-run planner artifact.
key_findings: The artifact is a cluster_plan with node_count 1000 and status PASS.
runtime.dry_run is true.
The sample nodes have no live container_id or pid.
This artifact is 1000-dry-run planner coverage only and must never be classified as real Valkey coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Read documented P14 dry-run template exception and gate-lock implications.
key_findings: The exception documents a two-virtual-AZ strengthening change for the 1000-node dry-run template.
The profile remains dry-run only and still requires the existing 1000-node opt-in guard.
Generated dry-run plans represent logical Valkey processes and no process/container execution by default.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect management metric and missing/skipped semantics.
key_findings: The report records 6 passed operations and 4 SKIPPED_WITH_REASON operations.
Skipped destructive or deferred operations include remove_node, reshard, rebalance, and rolling_restart.
L03 must not flatten skipped operations into failed, passed, or measured coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect workload metrics and skipped fault-window semantics.
key_findings: The report includes requested_qps, achieved_qps, latency metrics, operation counts, and errors.
before_fault, during_fault, and after_recovery timing windows are SKIPPED_WITH_REASON because the P05 workload_smoke has no fault or recovery window.
L03 must preserve those windows as skipped, not zero-duration measured windows.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect JSONL metric-sample shape and unit normalization risk.
key_findings: The JSONL records contain nested cluster, docker, logs, and valkey metric groups.
Some docker metrics are strings with embedded units or percentages, while Valkey and cluster metrics are numeric.
L03 must capture units and source JSON paths explicitly rather than coercing strings into fabricated numeric values.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect sandbox-fault metric and safety evidence.
key_findings: Safety checks record sandbox_only true, host_network_mutated false, global_firewall_mutated false, and fault_state_cleared true.
Observed impact is SKIPPED_WITH_REASON because the safety gate validates lifecycle and health without host-level impairment.
L03 must keep safety/lifecycle coverage separate from measured network-impact coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect failover metrics and explicit missing split-brain metric.
key_findings: primary_stop_observed and promotion_observed are true.
failover_latency_ms is measured as 408.125.
split_brain_duration_ms is MISSING with value null and reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate.
L03 must preserve that MISSING metric and must not infer split-brain duration from promotion success.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect analysis metrics and report-view boundary.
key_findings: analysis_summary.json records source_artifacts with path and sha256 entries from P08 and includes a MISSING split_brain_duration_ms metric.
report_index.json records CSV, SVG, Markdown, and HTML report outputs generated from analysis_summary.json.
Report outputs may be cataloged as views, but they must not become source_artifacts for metric truth when JSON sources exist.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect stability metrics and no-baseline semantics.
key_findings: The report includes bounded soak profile, workload latency, restart deltas, leak summary, and baseline comparison.
The first baseline source is SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and comparison entries are NO_BASELINE_YET.
L03 must not treat missing baseline deltas as zero change.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect representative 30-node real Valkey evidence.
key_findings: The evidence is produced by scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py.
real_valkey is true, status PASS, nodes_observed is 30, cluster_state_observed is ok, data_path_result is PASS, and valkey_versions includes 9.1.0.
This belongs in the 30 real layer, not the small-real or 1000-dry-run layers.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect representative 50/100 scale metrics and real evidence.
key_findings: The scale ladder report includes real_evidence_paths for 50 and 100 node evidence and rungs with memory and command metrics.
valkey_e2e_evidence_100.json is real_valkey true with status PASS, nodes_observed 100, cluster_state_observed ok, data_path_result PASS, and Valkey 9.1.0.
Derived rung metrics must remain linked to their evidence path and must not be promoted to raw live-proof metrics without lineage.

findings.description: L03 can overstate scale coverage if it treats any 1000-node artifact as real Valkey evidence instead of 1000-dry-run planner coverage.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P02_PLANNER/scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json has node_count 1000 and status PASS, but runtime.dry_run is true and nodes have no live container_id or pid.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json records P14 real_valkey_coverage false and real_evidence_count 0.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json has no P14 nodes or edges.
codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md requires a distinct 1000-dry-run layer and says 1000 dry-run must not be real coverage.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if any metric_catalog or coverage_matrix entry classifies P02 scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json, absent P14 artifacts, resource preflight, or planner dry-run output as real_valkey coverage, measured live-node coverage, or a substitute for P14 execution.
findings.required_safeguard: Require coverage_layer enum values including 1000-dry-run; require real_valkey_coverage=false, dry_run_only=true, and source_artifact pointing to the dry-run planner/preflight artifact for that layer.

findings.description: L03 can fabricate completeness by converting missing, skipped, or no-baseline metrics into numeric zero, PASS, or measured coverage.
evidence: P08 failover_report.json records split_brain_duration_ms as MISSING with value null and reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate.
P04 management_ops_report.json records remove_node, reshard, rebalance, and rolling_restart as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
P05 workload_report.json records before_fault, during_fault, and after_recovery as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
P11 stability_report.json records baseline_source SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and comparison status NO_BASELINE_YET.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if a missing, skipped, null, or no-baseline value is emitted as 0, PASS, measured, or covered without preserving status and reason.
findings.required_safeguard: Metric catalog schema must require explicit missing semantics for non-measured values: status MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET; value must be null when unknown; reason must be non-empty.

findings.description: L03 can violate artifact-first provenance by deriving metric truth from generated CSV, SVG, HTML, or Markdown report views instead of source JSON/JSONL artifacts.
evidence: AGENTS.md states charts, HTML, and markdown reports are views over versioned artifacts.
P09 report_index.json hashes generated metrics.csv, missing_metrics.csv, baseline_comparison.csv, metric_chart.svg, report.md, and index.html.
P09 analysis_summary.json is the machine-readable analysis artifact with source_artifacts and metric statuses.
L02 provenance_graph.json distinguishes source-of-truth nodes from report_view nodes.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py reads report/*.csv, report/*.svg, report/*.html, or report/*.md as a source of metric truth when an upstream JSON or JSONL artifact exists, or if metric_catalog source_artifact points only to a report view for a measured metric.
findings.required_safeguard: Treat report outputs as view artifacts only; require every metric entry to carry source_artifact, source_kind, artifact_type, and, for derived analysis metrics, lineage to source JSON/JSONL artifacts via provenance_graph.json.

findings.description: L03 can hide gaps by broadly editing historical artifacts, gate results, audits, or provenance inventory rather than reporting coverage gaps in new L03 outputs.
evidence: L03 read_context.md explicitly says not to mutate historical phase/gate artifacts to make metric coverage look better.
L03 previous_harness_result.json says timestamp-only audit/provenance churn and tracked bytecode were restored after baseline validation.
audit_report.json records historical nonblocking findings such as manifest SHA drift and a P13 command mismatch.
AGENTS.md protects harness controls and forbids weakening schemas/scripts/gates to hide changes.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if implementation modifies artifacts/phases, artifacts/gates, audit decisions, codex/phase_manifest.json, codex/gate_lock.json, existing schemas, existing gate scripts, or existing tests to improve apparent coverage without a recorded harness_exception and a stricter before/after behavior.
findings.required_safeguard: L03 builder must write only artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/metric_catalog.json and artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/coverage_matrix.json as generated report artifacts; anti-regression must inspect protected paths and historical artifact diffs.

findings.description: L03 can pass with empty or vague outputs if new schemas make required metric identity, source, layer, unit, and missing semantics optional or allow unbounded free-form rows.
evidence: codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md requires every metric to have name, unit, source_artifact, scenario, node_count_scope, and missing semantics.
schemas/artifact/metric_sample.schema.json currently allows nested free-form metrics, so L03's catalog schema must add stronger normalization rather than inherit all looseness.
03_HARNESS_POLICY.md blocks deleting schema fields, lowering requirements, or converting required behavior to optional.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if metric_catalog.schema.json or coverage_matrix.schema.json allow missing name/unit/source_artifact/scenario/node_count_scope/missing_semantics, allow coverage rows without layer status, or weaken any pre-existing schema/test requirement.
findings.required_safeguard: New schemas must require non-empty arrays, strict status and coverage-layer enums, source path fields, source status fields, layer-specific evidence classification, and explicit MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON semantics.

findings.description: The coverage matrix can conceal gaps if it collapses fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run into one aggregate covered/not-covered value.
evidence: L03 manifest requires fake/small-real/30/50/100/1000-dry-run layers.
P06 provides small-real observability metrics, P12 provides 30-node real evidence, P13 provides 50/100-node real evidence, and P02 provides 1000-node dry-run planning only.
P14 artifacts are absent and audit_report.json classifies P14 as opt-in dry-run not run.
Several domains have measured small-real coverage but missing or skipped scale/fault-specific metrics.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if coverage_matrix.json omits any required layer for any required domain, reports aggregate coverage without layer detail, or marks a domain covered when one or more required layer cells are MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
findings.required_safeguard: Coverage matrix schema must require an explicit cell per domain and layer with status, reason for non-covered cells, source_artifacts, evidence_class, real_valkey_coverage, and dry_run_only.

findings.description: Heterogeneous metric formats can lead to bad normalization, especially docker metrics encoded as strings with units and percentages.
evidence: P06 metrics_timeseries.jsonl has docker.cpu_percent as a string like 0.29%, memory_usage as MiB text, and block/net IO as textual pairs.
P05 workload_report.json has numeric qps and latency values with unit metadata.
P13 scale_ladder_report.json has memory and command counts in numeric derived fields.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if string metrics with embedded units are coerced into numeric values without explicit parser semantics, or if catalog entries omit unit and raw_value/value separation.
findings.required_safeguard: Catalog entries should preserve raw_value for unparsed strings, record unit or unit_status, and only emit numeric value when the parser and unit are explicit.

findings.description: L03 can hide L02's remaining missing metadata findings by treating provenance PASS as complete source metadata coverage.
evidence: provenance_graph.json status is PASS but summary.missing_metadata_count is 11.
L02 stage_result.json records historical optional metadata as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON rather than invented values.
audit_report.json has low/medium historical findings that remain relevant context for catalog completeness.
findings.blocker_condition: Block L03 if metric_catalog.json or coverage_matrix.json claims full provenance metadata completeness while L02 findings remain unresolved or unrepresented.
findings.required_safeguard: Carry provenance metadata status into catalog/matrix summaries and surface missing metadata as non-measured or partial metadata coverage with finding references.

proposed_harness.name: metric_catalog_schema_strict_required_fields
proposed_harness.acceptance: schemas/artifact/metric_catalog.schema.json rejects empty catalogs, entries missing name/unit/source_artifact/scenario/node_count_scope/missing_semantics, and entries with MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON but no reason.

proposed_harness.name: coverage_matrix_layer_boundary_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: schemas/artifact/coverage_matrix.schema.json requires fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layer cells; each cell has status, evidence_class, real_valkey_coverage, dry_run_only, source_artifacts, and reason for non-covered status.

proposed_harness.name: p02_1000_dryrun_not_real_fixture
proposed_harness.acceptance: A fixture based on artifacts/phases/P02_PLANNER/scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json produces only 1000-dry-run planner coverage with real_valkey_coverage=false and never satisfies a real 1000-node layer.

proposed_harness.name: missing_metric_semantics_negative_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests fail if split_brain_duration_ms MISSING, P04 skipped operations, P05 skipped fault windows, P07 skipped observed impact, or P11 NO_BASELINE_YET metrics are converted to zero/PASS/measured.

proposed_harness.name: report_view_poison_test
proposed_harness.acceptance: Changing generated report CSV/HTML/SVG/Markdown fixture values without changing source JSON/JSONL does not alter metric_catalog measured values; views are classified as report_view only.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_lineage_integration
proposed_harness.acceptance: The builder consumes provenance_graph.json and audit_report.json for source classification and emits metadata_status/finding references for L02 missing metadata without inventing fields.

proposed_harness.name: historical_artifact_mutation_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI or anti-regression validation fails if L03 changes historical artifacts/gates/audit decisions or weakens protected harness/schema/test files outside the declared L03 additions.

implementation_plan.step: Encode L03 schemas with strict required metric identity, source, layer, unit, evidence, and missing-semantics fields.
implementation_plan.rationale: The schemas are the first line of defense against empty outputs, hidden gaps, and dry-run/real conflation.

implementation_plan.step: Design the builder to read machine-readable JSON/JSONL artifacts and L02 provenance/audit reports, while treating CSV/SVG/HTML/Markdown as view artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: L03 must normalize real artifacts while preserving lineage and avoiding report-view derivation.

implementation_plan.step: Add fixtures and tests for P02 1000 dry-run classification, P14 absence, explicit MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON semantics, and required layer cells.
implementation_plan.rationale: The highest-risk failures are classification mistakes that can look plausible in aggregate output.

implementation_plan.step: Generate only L03 report artifacts and validate them by schema without mutating historical phase/gate artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Historical evidence must stay immutable; gaps belong in the new catalog/matrix, not in rewritten source artifacts.

implementation_plan.step: Run validation and anti-regression checks after implementation, excluding P14 and real/fault wrapper gates unless a separate user opt-in task authorizes them.
implementation_plan.rationale: L03 is a static artifact/catalog stage and should validate committed evidence rather than produce new live evidence.

acceptance_criteria: metric_catalog.json validates against metric_catalog.schema.json and every entry has name, unit or unit_status, source_artifact, source_json_path or source_field, scenario, phase_id, run_id when available, node_count_scope, coverage_layer, evidence_class, and missing_semantics.

coverage_matrix.json validates against coverage_matrix.schema.json and contains explicit fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layer cells for cluster build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, report, and visualization domains.
1000-node planner/preflight artifacts are represented only in the 1000-dry-run layer with real_valkey_coverage=false and dry_run_only=true.
No P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py command is run for L03.
Metrics with MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET status preserve null values and non-empty reasons; none are converted to 0, PASS, measured, or covered.
Generated report views under report/*.csv, report/*.svg, report/*.html, and report/*.md are never source_artifacts for measured metrics when JSON/JSONL sources exist.
The builder surfaces L02 provenance missing metadata findings in L03 metadata coverage instead of hiding them behind provenance PASS.
The implementation does not mutate historical artifacts/phases, artifacts/gates, audit decisions, codex/gate_lock.json, codex/phase_manifest.json, or existing schemas/tests to manufacture coverage.
risks: Over-counting P02 or absent P14 1000-node dry-run artifacts as real Valkey coverage.
Inventing numeric values for explicit MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET metrics.
Using report views as source-of-truth because they are easier to parse than upstream JSON/JSONL artifacts.
Mutating historical artifacts or broadening allowlists to make catalog coverage look complete.
Writing loose schemas that validate empty matrices or omit required layers.
Collapsing layer-level gaps into aggregate coverage values that obscure what was measured at each scale.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN during L03.
Do not run scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py during this risk-auditor task or L03 static catalog validation.
Do not count P02 scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json or any dry-run/resource/planner artifact as real Valkey evidence.
Do not derive measured metric values from CSV, SVG, HTML, or Markdown report views when JSON/JSONL source artifacts exist.
Do not fill missing metrics with 0, empty strings, PASS, or inferred values.
Do not edit historical artifacts under artifacts/phases, artifacts/gates, or audit to improve apparent metric coverage.
Do not weaken existing schemas, gate scripts, tests, phase manifest requirements, or gate lock controls to make L03 pass.
Do not collapse required coverage layers into a single covered boolean.
notes: APPROVED for L03 design and implementation to proceed if the blocker conditions above are encoded into stage_design.md, current_harness_plan.json, schemas, builder tests, validation, and anti-regression. This audit did not modify code and did not run P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.
